rows.name: Maria Magdalena Theresia Žubrinić
rows.relation: daughter of Michaël Žubrinić and Maria Marković, Otočac
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - Conditio «Agricola Confiniarius», no village or house number given; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-G5D9

rows.name: Mathias Žubrinić
rows.relation: son of Michael Žubrinić and Maria Marković, Šumećica N° 5
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - «Confiniarius e Sumećica N° 5», first entry of 1855 below the year rule; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-PVT8

rows.name: Josephus Žubrinić
rows.relation: son of Michael Žubrinić and Maria Rogić, Prozor N° 50
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - «Miles Gregarius e Prozor N° 50»; brother of Nikola Miko b. 8 Jan 1858, who is in the tree; ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99C-PK64

rows.name: Stephanus Žubrinić
rows.relation: son of Michael Žubrinić and Maria Marković, Šumećica N° 5
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 p. 290 - «Rusticus e Sumećica N° 5»; brother of Marta 1849 and Magdalena 1852, who are in the tree; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-PVGY

rows.name: Maria Žubrinić
rows.relation: daughter of Michael Žubrinić and Magdalena Glavinić, Prozor N° 49
rows.citation: Rodjeni 1846-1858 - «Rustica e Prozor N° 49»; surname written Žubrinić on the page where the index reads «Dubrinić»; ark 3:1:3QS7-899C-PVLN

rows.name: Mare Antić
rows.relation: daughter of Josip (ahnentafel 24) and Maria Antić, Selce N° 74; sister of ahnentafel 12
rows.citation: LIBER DEFUNCTORUM p. 99 - «Preminu Osip Antić težak i Mare kćer», aged 6, «Od kolere», father and daughter in one entry; ark 3:1:3QSQ-G99X-13PY

rows.name: Matilda Papić
rows.relation: third name on the stone cross of Josip Papić (ahnentafel 6) and Antonija — almost certainly their daughter
rows.citation: Senj municipal cemetery, «MATILDA ✽1895 †1921», read at 4x. NOT IN THE TREE UNDER THIS NAME: the tree has two Papić daughters born 1895 — Franka (20 Jan) and Sulka (7 Feb) — and neither has a death recorded. One of them may be this woman; IMG_8131

rows.name: Antonius Gergacs
rows.relation: son of Nicolaus Gerkacs (ahnentafel 220), and therefore a brother of ahnentafel 110
rows.event: named in his father's death entry
rows.citation: Karlobag Umrli 1774-1804 folio 39 — his father «obiit … in domo filij sui Antonij», died in this son's house. Not in the published tree; the Gerkacs collaterals are not published at all; ark 3:1:3QS7-L99C-GSBH

rows.name: Margaritha Smojver
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 212 and 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed, entry 270 — «Entry for Margaritham Smoiver and Josephi Smoiver»; mother Antoniae. ark 1:1:QKMX-YLY7. Born twelve years after her parents' marriage of 20 Nov 1752 and twelve years before her father's death in 1776

rows.name: Joseip Pekasu
rows.relation: son of Šimun Pekas of Karlobag; candidate brother of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Šimun Pekasu». The earliest Pekas entry found; his own daughter Antonia is baptised 1742

rows.name: Margarita Pekasa
rows.relation: daughter of Šimun Pekas of Karlobag; candidate sister of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Simon Pekasa», no mother named

rows.name: Katarina Pekasa
rows.relation: daughter of Šimun Pekas and STOJA; candidate half-sister of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Stoja, Simuna Pekasa». The mother is NOT Mare

rows.name: Perina Pekasa
rows.relation: daughter of Šimun Pekas and MARE; candidate sister of ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Simuna Pekasa, Mare». Mare is the only wife named that matches ahnentafel 427, Mara Pekass

rows.name: Antonia Pehasa
rows.relation: daughter of Osip Pekas and Monde, Karlobag — explicitly NOT ahnentafel 213
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Monde, Osipa Pehasa». Recorded here to rule her out: ahnentafel 213 married in 1752 and bore a son in 1754, so a girl baptised 1742 cannot be her

rows.name: Antonü Bechi (Bacchi)
rows.relation: second son of ahnentafel 428 and 429, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Angelo Bechi × Catharina», ark 1:1:QKMX-B9R1. A brother of ahnentafel 214, born twenty months after him under the same two parents

rows.name: Hevam Uroda
rows.relation: daughter of ahnentafel 108 and 109, and not in the tree
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Georgio Uroda × Maria». THE SECOND OF THAT NAME: Heva Joanna was baptised to the same couple on 28 December 1769, so either the first died and the name was reused, or the index holds one child twice

rows.name: Mikola Luckinicha

rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Vicka Luckinicha», no mother named; ark 1:1:QKMX-YTMT

rows.name: Mare Luckinicha
rows.relation: daughter of a Vicko Luckinić of Karlobag; CANDIDATE elder sister of ahnentafel 105
rows.citation: Karlobag births, indexed — «Parents Vicka Luckinicha», no mother named; ark 1:1:QKMX-YVND. Two years before ahnentafel 105 was born in the same parish to a father of the same name
